summary:
I have been working in different branches of the German education system and in HR-development.
I have held various positions amongst others as a study coordinator at the CDTM (an Institute of LMU and TUM Munich) for the honors degree Technology Management and also as a coordinator for Highschool-University relations at the TUM.
I am experienced in counseling and in the coordination of different projects from Mentoring for Highschool students to scientific and administrative projects.
